description: BESPOKE DESCRIPTION OF DEVELOPMENT (FOR THE PURPOSES OF THE CONSULTATION LETTER) RELATING TO 3 CONCURRENT NON-MATERIAL AMENDMENT APPLICATIONS : 26/03130/NMA; 26/03131/NMA & 26/03132/NMA. 26/03130/NMAAmendments to application referenced RN: 19/03701/FULL dated 20th December 2019:Namely, to vary the wording of condition 9 to facilitate the use of the existing floodlights to be used for drone shows scheduled for 20 and 21 November 2026 (with reserve dates in case of bad weather for 12 and 13 February 2027) between the hours of 16.30 and 18.00 (to facilitate safe access to seating) and 18.40-19.40 to facilitate safe egress following the show). 26/03131/NMAAmendments to application referenced RN:19/03696/FULL dated 20 September 2019:NAMELY to vary the wording of condition 1 to facilitate the use of the existing floodlights to be used for drone shows scheduled for 20 and 21 November 2026 (with reserve dates in case of bad weather for 12 and 13 February 2027) between the hours of 16.30 and 18.00 (to facilitate safe access to seating) and 18.40-19.40 to facilitate safe egress following the show).26/03132/NMAAmendments to application referenced RN: 19/03697/FULL dated 22 October 2019:NAMELY to vary the wording of condition 15 to facilitate the use of the existing floodlights to be used for drone shows scheduled for 20 and 21 November 2026 (with reserve dates in case of bad weather for 12 and 13 February 2027) between the hours of 16.30 and 18.00 (to facilitate safe access to seating) and 18.40-19.40 to facilitate safe egress following the show).
